title: Gobby ghook delivery receipt
description: Acknowledgment ghook enqueues after a successful emission-plus-flush. The daemon drain consumes this without re-executing the original hook.

schema_version.description: Delivery-receipt schema version; consumers must reject unknown versions.

kind.description: Discriminator so drain can route receipts away from hook execution.

enqueued_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when ghook enqueued this acknowledgment.

receipt_id.description: Durable receipt-effects row identity echoed from the daemon response.

original_envelope_id.description: Immutable envelope id of the first carrying envelope for this receipt.

delivery_generation.description: Monotonic delivery generation the acknowledgment commits.
